description: Gray + Gaussian + global Otsu + open/close + fill holes
note: FAIL: assumes egg is the bright region; many eggs are brown/dark and background is bright -> picks wall, cloth, hand
reason: Assumed the egg is the bright region. Dataset has brown/dark eggs on bright walls, trays and cloth, so it picked the background.

note: FAIL (slightly better): same polarity assumption; whiteness picks bright wall/tray/hand instead of the egg
reason: Whiteness cue is better than raw grey but still the same polarity assumption; same failure.

reason: Both polarities + 5 channels fixed the polarity problem and the count error (MAE 1.5 -> 0.46), but my hand-set score weights picked small corner regions over the big smooth egg.

description: Learned proposal ranker (Ridge on 25 shape/edge/colour/consensus features, 5-fold grouped CV on dev), thr_add=0.5
reason: Learning the weights (linear) helped a lot (F1 0.49 -> 0.68) but a linear score cannot express interactions such as 'large AND smooth AND high contrast'.
